title: "Plots_RescueData"
author: "Ben Wasserman"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(viridis)
library(ggpubr)
library(colorspace)
library(grid)
library(gdata)
library(str2str)
library(parallel)
library(beepr)

```

```{r loaddata}

#load("RescueDataUpdated.Rdata")
#load("RescueDataMutationTest3.Rdata")
load("RescueData_Revision3.Rdata")
#load("Rescuedata_omega20.Rdata")
```

```{r prepare}

#To add the omega2grad = 20 data but keep these tiles the same, I manually recoded to 12, but I need to turn that off for future uses
Paramsum$Sel[which(Paramsum$Sel==(0.05))]<-(1/12)
rescuecombplot$Sel[which(rescuecombplot$Sel==(0.05))]<-(1/12)
rescue_recipcombplot$Sel[which(rescue_recipcombplot$Sel==(0.05))]<-(1/12)

difflabs <- c("Nearest Neighbor", "Match 1EV", "Match 2EVs", "Match Phenotypes", "Genetic Mixture", "Adjust for 1EV", "Adjust for 2EV")
names(difflabs) <- c("DemographicDiff", "GradDiff", "GradEnvDiff", "PhenDiff", "MultipleDiff", "GradAdjDiff", "GradEnvAdjDiff")

spacer <- rep(2,4)

xsmalltxtsize <- 6
smalltxtsize <- 6
lgtxtsize <- 6

 keywidth <- 0.3
  keyheight <- 0.5

  cexall <- 0.75
  #put in the NAs for extant manuaully where they are for popsize

  #selection labels
#sellabs <- c("1", "", "1/3", "", "1/5", "", "1/7", "", "1/9", "")
sellabs <- c("1", "1/3", "1/5", "1/7", "1/9")

rescuecombplotsave <-rescuecombplot
rescuecombplot$Value[which((rescue_recipcombplot$Sel==1)&(rescue_recipcombplot$Mig%in%c(0.001,0.0001))&(rescue_recipcombplot$EnvType=="Variable")&(rescue_recipcombplot$Variable%in%c("Extant", "Pop.Size")))]<-NA
  
rescue_recipcombplotsave <-rescue_recipcombplot
rescue_recipcombplot$Value[which((rescue_recipcombplot$Sel==1)&(rescue_recipcombplot$Mig%in%c(0.001,0.0001))&(rescue_recipcombplot$EnvType=="Variable")&(rescue_recipcombplot$Variable=="Extant"))]<-NA

  
```


```{r plotallpops}
  
#Fixed Environment

fexplot <- ggplot(data = filter(rescuecombplot, ((EnvType == "Fixed")&(Variable == "Extant"))), aes(x = log10(Mig+0.000001), y = -(1/Sel), fill = Value)) + geom_tile() + facet_grid(.~Diff, labeller = labeller(Diff = difflabs)) + scale_fill_gradient2(name = "Populations\nExtant", limits = range(filter(rescuecombplot, ((EnvType == "Fixed")&(Variable == "Extant")))$Value), low = "red", mid = "white", high = "blue", midpoint = 0) + scale_x_continuous(name = NULL, breaks = log10(c(0.000001, 0.00001, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1)), labels = c("0", "1e-05", "1e-04", "1e-03", "1e-02", "1e-01")) + scale_y_continuous(name = NULL, breaks = seq(-1,-9,by=-2), labels = sellabs) + theme_classic() + theme(plot.margin = unit(spacer, "points"), axis.text.y = element_text(size = xsmalltxtsize), axis.text.x  = element_text(size = smalltxtsize, angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1), legend.title=element_text(size = lgtxtsize), legend.text = element_text(size = smalltxtsize), legend.key.width = unit(keywidth, "lines"), legend.key.height = unit(keyheight, "lines"), strip.text = element_text(size = xsmalltxtsize))
```
